name: Cam Thanh Coconut Water
kicker: Basket boats in the nipa water
summary: Take a basket boat through the nipa water at Cẩm Thanh, about 3 km from the old town on the 2022 heritage article. From 10 August 2026 the entry is 30,000 VND a person. The boat is extra, and that price is check on arrival. Seventeen routes were approved in February 2025. Bad weather can stop the boats.
getThere: About 3 km from the old town. Confirm the minutes.
heroCaption: A basket boat under the nipa palms, with water in front

notice.title: The entry fee is not the boat
notice.body: From 10 August 2026 the visit is 30,000 VND a person. The basket boat is extra. A 2022 article printed boat prices, and no later page updates them. Ask the boat price before you sit down.

body: The ride is a basket boat through the nipa palms at Võng Nhi, Cẩm Thanh, now inside Hoi An Đông. The November 2022 heritage article says the palms were brought from the Mekong delta about 200 years ago, and that the name still says seven mẫu though the water is larger now. The February 2025 notice says the city approved 17 boat routes. Thirteen use landing points the state manages. Four are aimed at landing points a person or a company would run. In the centre, seven routes are the lively ones and six are the quiet ones. Two routes are for the biosphere buffer and the bamboo-and-coconut craft village. Two more are quiet routes outside that centre.

Plan a boat hour, not a museum morning. The 2022 article printed 45 minutes for a wooden boat and suggested early morning or after 15:30. That clock and that hour are one article. Confirm them on arrival. The February 2025 notice says the commune stops the basket boats when the weather is bad.

The entry fee is settled. From 10 August 2026, Resolution 94/2026 of 31 July 2026 sets 30,000 VND a person a visit. The city portal on 7 August 2026 and the council note on 14 September 2026 print the same figure. The boat is not in that fee. The 2022 boat prices stay off this page. They are not a current tariff.

figures.caption: Nipa trunks standing in the water
figures.alt: A stand of nipa palms with thick trunks at the edge of the water near Cam Thanh

gettingThere: The November 2022 heritage article places the water at Võng Nhi, Cẩm Thanh, about 3 km from the old-town centre and about 5 minutes by car. That is one article. No second clock was found. Confirm the minutes on arrival. Cẩm Thanh is now inside Hoi An Đông.

legs.heading: From the old town
legs.body: About 3 km, and about 5 minutes by car, on the November 2022 heritage article. No second clock. Confirm the minutes on arrival.

hours: Check on arrival. February 2025 notice: basket boats 07:00–18:00. November 2022 article: summer 07:30–18:30, winter 08:00–17:00.
closed: The commune can stop the boats in bad weather. The 2022 article does not say which months are summer and winter.
admissionNote: Entry is 30,000 VND a person a visit from 10 August 2026, under Resolution 94/2026 of 31 July 2026. The city portal and the council’s September 2026 note print the same figure. The portal’s free cases are Vietnamese disabled people with the certificate, Vietnamese people covered by the 2003 cultural-access decision, children under 16 and pupils, Vietnamese citizens 60 and over, and diplomatic guests. The council note says some groups are free and does not repeat the list. The basket boat is extra. The 2022 article’s boat prices are not used here. The boat price is check on arrival.
